title: time_input widget Android style.
body:
### Problem

The current dropdown-list time_input widget is impractical if you need to scroll the list to  search for a specific time.
It is also not self evident, after clicking on the input box, that you can also write a time into it (backspace does not delete the previous text).

### Solution
I would adopt the widely used Android widget instead, as in [Material Design](https://material.io/components/time-pickers/android#using-time-pickers). 

It is a lot more intuitive and practical:

![unnamed](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25978536/194877161-85cb1269-002d-412b-be38-bc24643801de.png)

### Voting for feature requests

**If you'd like the Streamlit team to prioritize this feature request, please use the 👍 (thumbs up emoji) reaction in response to the initial post.**

comments.body:
That's a cool idea and I think we should definitely do this at some point! Thanks for the suggestion. I don't think it will be high priority though because a) the [BaseWeb library](https://baseweb.design/components/time-picker/#time-picker) that we use under the hood doesn't offer such a component, so we'd need to build something oursevles and b) `st.time_input` isn't used that often compared to other widgets. 

I think this could also be a great candidate to [build a custom component](https://docs.streamlit.io/library/components/create) if you're interested in that [USER]!

As an alternative solution I could suggest usage of HTML native, time input field: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/time. 

It has great support (96.87% as of https://caniuse.com/input-datetime) and widget rendering is delegated to the browser. It is also supported by BaseWeb library via `Input` component: https://baseweb.design/components/input/.
